_comment: FiestaBoard Plugin Registry - Community and official external plugins
_naming_convention: All plugins listed here MUST use the fiestaboard-plugin--{name} repository naming convention

plugins.name: Air Quality & Fog
plugins.description: Display air quality (AQI), fog/visibility conditions, and pollen/allergen levels
plugins.author: FiestaBoard Team

plugins.name: Bay Wheels
plugins.description: Display Bay Wheels bike share availability with electric and classic bike counts
plugins.author: FiestaBoard Team

plugins.name: Dad Jokes
plugins.description: Display random dad jokes from the icanhazdadjoke API
plugins.author: FiestaBoard Team

plugins.name: Disney Parks Queue Times
plugins.description: Display wait times for Disney parks (Disneyland, California Adventure, Disney World, etc.) from Queue-Times.com
plugins.author: FiestaBoard Team

plugins.name: Generic Data
plugins.description: Fetch data from any URL (JSON or XML) and map fields to template variables — supports multiple feeds
plugins.author: FiestaBoard Team

plugins.name: Guest WiFi
plugins.description: Display guest WiFi credentials on your board
plugins.author: FiestaBoard Team

plugins.name: Allergy & Health
plugins.description: Display allergy levels (pollen counts) and health risk indicators for your area using Open-Meteo Air Quality data
plugins.author: FiestaBoard Team

plugins.name: Home Assistant
plugins.description: Display entity states from Home Assistant via REST API or MQTT Statestream
plugins.author: FiestaBoard Team

plugins.name: Last.fm Now Playing
plugins.description: Display what's currently playing via Last.fm scrobbling. Works with Apple Music, Spotify, and any scrobbling source.
plugins.author: FiestaBoard Team

plugins.name: SF Muni
plugins.description: Display San Francisco Muni transit arrival times with multi-line support
plugins.author: FiestaBoard Team

plugins.name: Nearby Aircraft
plugins.description: Display real-time nearby aircraft information from OpenSky Network API
plugins.author: FiestaBoard Team

plugins.name: Santa Tracker
plugins.description: Track Santa's journey around the world as midnight of December 25th hits famous locations in each timezone
plugins.author: FiestaBoard Team

plugins.name: Spacecraft Launches
plugins.description: Track upcoming spacecraft launch countdowns and statuses
plugins.author: FiestaBoard Team

plugins.name: Sports Scores
plugins.description: Display recent sports match scores from NFL, Soccer, NHL, and NBA
plugins.author: FiestaBoard Team

plugins.name: Star Trek Quotes
plugins.description: Display random Star Trek quotes from TNG, Voyager, and DS9
plugins.author: FiestaBoard Team

plugins.name: Stardate
plugins.description: Display the current TNG-style stardate
plugins.author: FiestaBoard Team

plugins.name: Stock Prices
plugins.description: Display real-time stock prices and percentage changes from Yahoo Finance
plugins.author: FiestaBoard Team

plugins.name: Sun Art
plugins.description: Display a full-screen sun art pattern that changes based on the sun's position throughout the day
plugins.author: FiestaBoard Team

plugins.name: Surf Conditions
plugins.description: Display surf conditions including wave height and swell period
plugins.author: FiestaBoard Team

plugins.name: Traffic
plugins.description: Display commute times and traffic conditions using Google Routes API
plugins.author: FiestaBoard Team

plugins.name: Visual Clock
plugins.description: Displays a full-screen clock with large pixel-art style digits.
plugins.author: FiestaBoard Team

plugins.name: Weather
plugins.description: Display current weather conditions with temperature, humidity, and wind speed
plugins.author: FiestaBoard Team

plugins.name: White Noise
plugins.description: Gentle rain / white noise mode — softly cascading tiles that create a soothing ambient pitter-patter
plugins.author: FiestaBoard Team

plugins.name: WSDOT
plugins.description: Washington State Ferries: schedules, vessel names, car spots, and alerts
plugins.author: FiestaBoard Team
